description: v1 compatibility differential fixture (Astra WS-2 re-review R1/R3, amendment A-19 item 7): independent BASELINE (dsOMOP 2.10.2) outcomes of v1 plans whose scalar fields or predicate literals are written in a historically coercible or invalid form. A baseline `ok` must keep executing with an identical lossless canonical result; a baseline `error` may be refused (typed where `typed_refusal`). Replayed by tests/testthat/test-ir-v1-compat.R.
generated_by: tools/ws2/capture_compat.R (run x2 at the baseline, then fixture)
plan_decoding: a case with `template` has the plan templates[[template]]$template with @V@ replaced by its `value` (a JSON literal); any other case has `plan`. Either is the transport JSON, decoded exactly as .ds_arg() decodes it: jsonlite::fromJSON(<plan>, simplifyVector = FALSE). `plan_sha256` is the sha256 of the decoded plan's 17-digit b10 canonical form.
result_encoding: baseline `ok`: `result_sha256` is the sha256 of the b10 canonical form of the .planExecute() value at 17 significant digits (lossless) as serialised by jsonlite::toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE, null = 'null', na = 'null', digits = NA, force = TRUE); `outputs` has each output's rows and columns for diagnostics. The full canonical forms are recomputed with tools/ws2/capture_compat.R (run on the baseline and on the current code, then diff).
execution: .planExecute(handle, plan, out_symbols) with every output name mapped to '<name>_df', on a fresh create_test_handle() after the case's `setup` (setups[[setup]]; issue_bins: .test_issue_safe_bins()), under `option_state` plus the case's `options` (`default_options` when absent); every other nfilter.* / dsomop.* / dsstaging.* / datashield.* option unset.

fields.baseline: status ok (result_sha256, outputs) or error (class, message, stage, refused_before_query, origin, data_statements_before, call); warnings; sql: the data statements of the concept_col cases
fields.stage: plan: a property of the plan alone; site: needs the site catalogue (including its blocked columns) or dialect; executor: the database or R failed on the value while running; data: needs the data (disclosure gates, vocabulary, empty populations); session: server-issued session state (safe-bin contracts, handle-owned temp cohorts)
fields.ir_expectation: accept: .irPrepare(plan) without a handle must accept (baseline ok); refuse: it must refuse with a dsomop_plan_rejection (baseline refused at the plan stage); none: no plan-level expectation (baseline refused at another stage)
fields.typed_refusal: the current refusal must inherit dsomop_plan_rejection (R1 malformed shapes)
fields.disposition: '' or a reviewed deviation {current: 'refused' | 'ok', reference, note}; the test then asserts `current` instead of the baseline equivalence

filter_tree.safe_scope.concept_id.reads: .assertSafeNumericBinContract() concept_id; scope must match the concept

event_level.concept_set.scalar.reads: .compileSelect() concept_filter (a JSON scalar for a one-item list)
